name: Disjoint Set Visible Plane Optimization
definition: Optimizes a 2D VisiblePlane by merging contiguous regions of solid voxels with the same ID into single mesh quads using a Disjoint Set Union (DSU) data structure.
summary: Disjoint Set Visible Plane Optimization is a greedy meshing algorithm that merges contiguous identical voxels into rectangular quads on pre-culled 2D planes using a Disjoint Set Union data structure.
